team_section.title: The Lychen Team
team_section.description: We are a group of dedicated individuals united by a common mission: building a sustainable and innovative ecosystem. Everyone brings their unique expertise to move the project forward.

ecosystem_section.title: Discover how we build the ecosystem
ecosystem_section.description: Our approach is based on collaboration, transparency, and innovation. We believe in creating solutions that benefit all stakeholders in the ecosystem.
